moves.me-first: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target’s intended move with greater power. This move fails if it isn’t used first.
moves.toxic-spikes: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.flare-blitz: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.
moves.bug-buzz: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.focus-blast: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.energy-ball: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.earth-power: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.nasty-plot: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.avalanche: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.
moves.flash-cannon: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.lava-plume: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
moves.power-whip: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.
moves.stone-edge: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.chatter: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
moves.growl: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stat.
moves.seed-flare: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.round: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.
moves.echoed-voice: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, its power is increased.
moves.heal-pulse: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.shift-gear: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack stat and sharply raising its Speed stat.
moves.acid: The opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stat.
moves.retaliate: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move’s power is increased.
moves.water-pledge: A column of water strikes the target. When combined with its fire equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.
moves.fire-pledge: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass equivalent, its power increases and a vast sea of fire appears.
moves.grass-pledge: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.
moves.heat-crash: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.
moves.steamroller: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.searing-shot: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
moves.fusion-flare: The user brings down a giant flame. This move’s power is increased when influenced by an enormous lightning bolt.
moves.fusion-bolt: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move’s power is increased when influenced by an enormous flame.
moves.fell-stinger: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user’s Attack stat rises drastically.
moves.surf: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
moves.forests-curse: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
moves.draining-kiss: The user steals the target’s HP with a kiss. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.
moves.grassy-terrain: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass type-moves.
moves.misty-terrain: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
moves.diamond-storm: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply raise the user’s Defense stat.
moves.hyperspace-hole: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This also hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
moves.powder: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.
moves.electric-terrain: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.
moves.thousand-arrows: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
moves.thousand-waves: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can’t flee from battle.
moves.dragon-ascent: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds. But it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def stats in the process.
moves.shore-up: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
moves.first-impression: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
moves.baneful-bunker: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.spirit-shackle: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target’s shadow to the ground to prevent the target from escaping.
moves.darkest-lariat: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
moves.sparkling-aria: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.
moves.ice-hammer: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
moves.floral-healing: The user restores the target’s HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.
moves.high-horsepower: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
moves.strength-sap: The user restores its HP by the same amount as the target’s Attack stat. It also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.solar-blade: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light’s energy, attacking the target on the next turn.
moves.leafage: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
moves.spotlight: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
moves.toxic-thread: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.laser-focus: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
moves.gear-up: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.
moves.throat-chop: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.
moves.pollen-puff: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
moves.anchor-shot: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.psychic-terrain: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
moves.lunge: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.fire-lash: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.power-trip: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.
moves.burn-up: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
moves.speed-swap: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
moves.smart-strike: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
moves.purify: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.
moves.revelation-dance: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user’s type determines the type of this move.
moves.core-enforcer: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.trop-kick: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.instruct: The user instructs the target to use the target’s last move again.
moves.beak-blast: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it’s heating up its beak results in a burn.
moves.clanging-scales: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack the opposing Pokémon. The user’s Defense stat goes down after the attack.
moves.dragon-hammer: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
moves.brutal-swing: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
moves.aurora-veil: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
moves.strength: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.
moves.shell-trap: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on the opposing Pokémon.
moves.fleur-cannon: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.psychic-fangs: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.stomping-tantrum: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.
moves.accelerock: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
moves.liquidation: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.prismatic-laser: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can’t move on the next turn.
moves.spectral-thief: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
moves.sunsteel-strike: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
moves.moongeist-beam: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
moves.tearful-look: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.zing-zap: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target, giving it an electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.natures-madness: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target’s HP.
moves.multi-attack: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move’s type.
moves.photon-geyser: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.
moves.solar-beam: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
moves.poison-powder: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.
moves.dig: The user burrows, then attacks on the next turn.

abilities.stench: By releasing stench when attacking, this Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
abilities.volt-absorb: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move, instead of taking damage.
